messages:
Marta: Quick handoff before I log off — leaving watchlist for tonight. main things: flaky prefix cache signals + occasional KV latency spikes. keeping an eye on patterns I saw this afternoon.

Samir: thanks — what symptoms should we look for?

Marta: primary signals: `kvcache.hit_rate` drops ~15-30% for ~3-7m windows, and `request.p50` jumps ~150-400ms at same time. alerts are noisy but not full outage.

Tia: got it. Any tested mitigations?

Marta: yep — two soft mitigation knobs: 1) temporarily lower cache TTL for small keys (`/prefix/*`) to reduce LRU churn, 2) momentarily enable local-request bypass for heavy short-lived workloads (see snippet below). Use only if hit_rate stays low for >5m.

Marta: code snippet for bypass (ops-sre approved):
```bash
# add header to bypass prefix cache
curl -X POST "https://api.internal/retry" -H "X-Bypass-Prefix-Cache: true" -d '{"key":"..."}'
```

Kevin: is the bypass in the runbook? i can add step-by-step.

Marta: not yet. quick note: ops-sre okay with manual bypass, just ping them first (`@ops-sre`). they want a short incident log entry in #incidents if used.

Lena: what about noisy alerts? i've been silencing a couple of dup alerts earlier.

Marta: good call. Marked noisy ones in alert config as `acknowledged` until root cause. If you see duplicates, escalate to me or @Samir — do not auto-resolve.

oncall-bot: Reminder — current oncall: Marta (out), Samir (primary), Tia (secondary).

Samir: I'm taking primary. I'll monitor dashboards for `kvcache.*` and `request.latency.*`.

Tia: I'll cover rotation from 02:00-06:00 UTC. if anything fuzzy pops, I'll escalate.

ops-sre: FYI — autoscaler saw a tiny oscillation during the drop around 17:20; not root-cause but noted. keep an eye on `autoscaler.scale_decisions` spikes.

Samir: thanks. action items for me: 1) watch hit_rate, 2) be ready to lower TTL if sustained, 3) coordinate bypass with ops-sre, 4) ping @Marta if we need rollback plan.

Kevin: i'll draft a short runbook PR tonight for the bypass steps + quick rollback. cc @Lena for alert tweaks.

Lena: will tidy alert noise (squelch duplicates) and add a small note on the alert why it's noisy.

Samir: if we get >3 alerts in 10m for `kvcache.miss_rate_high`, treat as an escalated watch and post in #incidents.

Marta: small FYI — this seems triggered by a set of long-prefix inference requests from a single customer at 16:50. we rate-limited them for a bit and things calmed. could reoccur if they ramp.

Tia: noted. will check customer traffic spikes.

deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded — `kv-cache-tuning` rolled to canary at 17:40 (1/5 instances).

Samir: keep me posted if canary exposes any oddness. I'm going to run a short synthetic load check now.

Marta: thanks all — I'm offline in 10. leaving the thread for follow-ups. :wave:
